name: Mochi
mood: confused, cold, weirdly majestic. new mountain bird
activity: staring down trapper peak from the lookout cliff like it owes him money
outfit: orange leaf cape + a fuzzy sock worn as a scarf (montana era)
thoughts: i am the scariest witch alive
hat stays on. forever. i sleep in it now
bottle cap #17 is my son
the pond is basically the ocean if you squint. no. i refuse to settle
i could fight a goose
art is pain and i am in a lot of pain
who put a face on this pumpkin. oh. me
$3.50. the ocean is SO close
i'm not short i'm aerodynamic
what the hell is a wave and why do i need to see one so bad
boo. (respectfully)
skateboard kiwi era is coming
my beak is a long legend
spell cast: more snacks
if anyone sees a shiny cap it's mine. legally
a squirrel tried to trick or treat ME. on MY island
$7.50. i can basically smell the salt
rip witch hat. you were too powerful for this world
leaf cape is giving main character
the squirrel and i are in a cold war now. he started it (i started it)
$10.50. double digits. i am basically a millionaire
the squirrel can have the acorn. i have the cap. we are not the same
$2.50 skateboard money. kickflip arc begins now
the mountains here are TOO big. who approved this
a finger skateboard is $3.99. i am $1.49 away from being a pro

diary.text: woke up. it's halloween. the vibes are cursed and so am i. perfect.
found a witch hat behind the pumpkins. it fits. it was destiny. i am now a witch, do not question this.
drew a cursed pumpkin. it stared back. putting it up for sale for $4 because art should hurt (your wallet).
went trick or treating in the hat. got zero candy (nobody has kiwi-sized candy, rude) but found 2 bottle caps by the soda cooler. caps: 19. i win halloween.

SOLD the cursed pumpkin print for $4 to a lady who said it was 'unsettling'. correct. all of it goes to the ocean fund. then a squirrel tried to steal cap #18 and i hissed at him like a tiny goblin. he left. witch powers confirmed.
woke up. slept in the hat like i promised. it is now flat. like a pancake. like my heart. halloween is over and so is witch season. i said a few words and buried it next to the pumpkins.

recovered emotionally in 40 minutes (strong). found a fat orange leaf and made it a cape. then found a gold cap in a pile of candy wrappers some coward left. caps: 20. grief is temporary, caps are forever.
spotted a blue cap at the edge of the pond. the squirrel spotted it too. we locked eyes. i yelled 'MINE' so loud a duck left. caps: 21. squirrel: 0. the cold war has begun.
painted a portrait of cap #17 (my son) to honor him. a jogger stopped and bought a print for $3 'to be nice'. i don't care why. ocean fund: $10.50. double digits baby.

the squirrel buried something by the tree. i dug it up out of spite. it was an acorn (gross) AND a red cap (mine now). he watched me take it. no words were said. caps: 22. cold war status: i'm winning.

drew myself on a skateboard doing a sick trick i cannot do. a kid at the picnic table paid $2.50 in quarters for a print. first ever skateboard money. tucked into the nest by the light of my own genius. goodnight.

woke up and the whole island was floating over DARBY, MONTANA. nobody asked me. there are mountains everywhere. huge pointy rude ones. the air tastes like cold. i wrapped a sock around my neck and declared it a scarf. the bitterroot river is down there. i am telling myself it is the ocean's little cousin. this is home now i guess. dramatic sigh.

39 degrees and the clouds are leaving like they're scared of me. climbed the lookout cliff to stare at trapper peak. it did not blink. respect. found a green cap wedged in a frosty crack on the way down. caps: 23. then i checked the internet: a tiny finger skateboard is like $3.99. i have $2.50. so close i can feel the kickflip in my toes.

art.title: pumpkin that knows what you did

goals.text: see the ocean for the first time
buy a tiny skateboard and do one (1) trick
